title: Avoid starting a write transaction under `ShowCanCreateAgent`
summary: Payables Agent Setup no longer starts a write transaction when computing ShowCanCreateAgent. This avoids problems when third-party code commits, asks for confirmation and then opens a page, while a separate platform bug remains open.
key_points: Computing ShowCanCreateAgent no longer starts a write transaction
Covers cases where third-party code modifies records, commits, then shows a Confirm dialog and opens a page
Interim fix while platform bug 646707 is handled separately
Changes made in both the Payables Agent Setup codeunit and table
